title: Final Probability for s_x = 1/2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the probability P(s_x = 1/2) = cos^2(ωt/2).

title: Final Probability for s_x = -1/2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the probability P(s_x = -1/2) = sin^2(ωt/2).

title: Final Probability for s_y = 1/2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the probability P(s_y = 1/2) = cos^2(ωt/2 - π/4).

title: Final Probability for s_y = -1/2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the probability P(s_y = -1/2) = sin^2(ωt/2 - π/4).

title: Final Probability for s_z states
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that P(s_z = 1/2) = 1/2 and P(s_z = -1/2) = 1/2.

title: Use of Ehrenfest Theorem
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of Ehrenfest's theorem and its application to the problem.

title: Correctness of Angular Velocity
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the angular velocity ω = eB/mc and its role in the solution.

title: Probability Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a clear interpretation of the probabilities in the context of quantum mechanics.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of quantum mechanics principles.
